author: Seung Wook
problem: A diver's log is a comma-separated string of depth changes in whole metres, such as '5,3,x,2'; entries that aren't whole numbers were smudged by water. Return the sum of the readable entries.
bug_description: Filters with isdigit(), which is False for '-2', so negative depth changes are treated as smudged and skipped.

comments.accurate: Sum of the readable whole-number depth changes in the log
comments.wrong_behavior: Sum of the entries made only of digits; anything else counts as smudged
comments.wrong_location: Entry filter verified; check entries are split on commas
